display.purpose: Modal and section titles. The type ceiling — no hero exists in product UI.

title.purpose: Model names on tiles and rows; loudest element in a dense grid.

body.purpose: Controls, copy, secondary metadata. The workhorse.

label.purpose: Field labels and inline control text; muted ink.

mono.purpose: Every measured value, tag, file badge, and print setting.

kicker.purpose: Sparse tracked-uppercase system micro-label (e.g. SPECS). Never a per-section eyebrow.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Grid tile on hover, paired with a 2px upward translate. The only resting-element shadow.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs above a blur(7px) scrim.

motion.name: ui-fast
motion.purpose: State transitions on tiles, cards, list rows, buttons, chips.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Prescribed default easing for state transitions; every transition needs a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-emphasis action on a surface (Add model, Add to library). The cyan facet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#2cb4f5; color:#06151d; border:1px solid #2cb4f5; border-radius:9px; padding:9px 20px; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#4cc3ff; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2cb4f5; outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition:none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Non-primary action (Cancel, Tags / Groups). Transparent with a hairline border that shifts to cyan on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background:transparent; color:#c9c9cf; border:1px solid #34343a; border-radius:9px; padding:9px 18px; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#2cb4f5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2cb4f5; outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-ghost { transition:none; } }

components.name: Pill Chip
components.description: Filter / tag pill. Inactive is a graphite surface; selected fills the cyan facet (also the higher-contrast state, so selection reads without color).
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#1d1d20; color:#c9c9cf; border:1px solid #2c2c30; border-radius:99px; padding:5px 12px; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.5; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#2cb4f5; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2cb4f5; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chip-active { background:#2cb4f5; color:#06151d; border-color:#2cb4f5; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip { transition:none; } }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The one pill-shaped input — global search in the top bar. Faint placeholder held at the readable floor.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" placeholder="Search models, tags, creators — try “dragon”" />
components.css: .ds-input-search { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; background:#1d1d20; color:#eaeaec; border:1px solid #2c2c30; border-radius:99px; padding:9px 16px; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-size:13px; outline:none; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color:#6c6c73; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color:#2cb4f5; outline:2px solid rgba(44,180,245,0.4); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Model Tile
components.description: Square, image-first grid tile. Flat at rest; lifts on hover and reveals a name/creator/format scrim.
components.css: .ds-tile { position:relative; display:block; width:200px; aspect-ratio:1/1; padding:0; border:1px solid #26262a; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#1a1a1d; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s, box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-tile:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-color:#3e3e46; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2cb4f5; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tile-img { position:absolute; inset:0; background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, #34505f 0%, #17171a 82%); } .ds-tile-scrim { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:flex-end; padding:14px; text-align:left; background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(8,8,10,0.92) 0%, rgba(8,8,10,0.4) 30%, rgba(8,8,10,0) 58%); opacity:0; transition:opacity .16s ease; } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-scrim, .ds-tile:focus-visible .ds-tile-scrim { opacity:1; } .ds-tile-name { font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:650; font-size:14px; line-height:1.25; color:#eaeaec; } .ds-tile-meta { font-size:11.5px; color:#c2c2c9; margin-top:3px; } .ds-tile-badges { display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:8px; } .ds-tile-badge { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:#a8a8b0; background:rgba(28,28,32,0.85); border:1px solid #36363c; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tile { transition:none; } .ds-tile:hover { transform:none; } .ds-tile-scrim { transition:none; } }

components.name: Spec Row
components.description: Read-only label/value row in the detail view. Archivo key, JetBrains Mono value — the Measured-Value Rule made visible.
components.css: .ds-spec { display:grid; grid-template-columns:140px 1fr; gap:10px; padding:6px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #232327; font-size:12.5px; } .ds-spec-k { color:#8b8b93; font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; } .ds-spec-v { color:#e0e0e5; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:11.5px; }

narrative.overview: Lapidary is a dark velvet field with one bright facet of light. Surfaces recede into a near-black graphite (#121214); a single cyan accent (#2cb4f5) is the one cut that catches the light. The name is the brief: a lapidary cuts and polishes gems, and this interface treats each model as the gem under inspection — the chrome is the loupe, precise and almost invisible, and the model is the thing in focus. The personality is Precise · Fast · Trustworthy: instrument-like, confident, dense but always legible. Archivo carries the structure; JetBrains Mono carries the data. The accent is rationed: it marks the live thing and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal layering; depth from subtle borders, not heavy shadow.
A single rationed cyan accent — the facet, never decoration.
Dual-typeface system: Archivo for structure, JetBrains Mono for every measured value.
Image-first: the model fills the frame; metadata reveals on intent.
High density held calm by a tight type scale and rhythmic spacing.

rules.name: The One Facet Rule
rules.body: Loupe Cyan appears on a small fraction of any screen — the primary action, the current selection, the focus ring. Its rarity is the point; never use cyan for decoration, borders-at-rest, or body text.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by lightness and a hairline border, not by drop shadow. If two panels are hard to tell apart, raise the border one step on the ramp — do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Measured-Value Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a measurement — size, triangle count, file size, print setting, date — is set in JetBrains Mono. Anything that is a name or a sentence is set in Archivo.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The mono kicker is a sparse system accent, not section scaffolding. Never stack a tracked-uppercase label above every section.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces cast no shadow until they change state. Depth at rest is tone and border; depth on interaction is the Lift; depth above the app is the Float.

dos: Do ration Loupe Cyan to the live thing only — primary action, current selection, focus.
Do set every measured value in JetBrains Mono, and every name or sentence in Archivo.
Do build depth from tone + hairline borders; add a shadow only on hover-lift or for modals.
Do render a visible Loupe Cyan focus ring on every interactive control (the current code sets outline:none on inputs with no replacement — an accessibility gap to close).
Do carry a second, non-color cue for every state so the UI is legible to colorblind users (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Do give every transition a prefers-reduced-motion alternative.
Do keep body and placeholder text at ≥ 4.5:1 against its graphite surface.
donts: Don't ship consumer marketplace clutter — no ad rails, infinite-scroll noise, or social cruft.
Don't drift into heavy enterprise CAD/PLM — no gray nested toolbars or industrial-bleak density.
Don't apply the generic SaaS dashboard look — no purple gradients, identical card grids, hero-metric template, or per-section uppercase eyebrow.
Don't slip into playful / childish maker vibes — no cartoonish rounding, emoji chrome, or toy-like styling.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism (the modal blur is the one sanctioned use), or a colored side-stripe accent.
Don't let Loupe Cyan become a second neutral; if more than a small fraction of a screen is cyan, the facet is gone.
